import { useHydrated } from "#src/hooks/use-hydrated.ts";

export const ModeToggle = () => {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const hydrated = useHydrated();

  return (
    <ThemeMenu disabled={!hydrated} onValueChange={setTheme} value={theme} />
  );
};

const graphemes = new Intl.Segmenter(undefined, { granularity: "grapheme" });

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/u)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map(
      (word) =>
        graphemes.segment(word).containing(0)?.segment.toUpperCase() ?? ""
    )
    .join("");

export const AccountMenu = (props: { name: string; onSignOut: () => void }) => (
  <Menu>
    <MenuTrigger aria-label={props.name} class="rounded-full border p-2">
      {initials(props.name)}
    </MenuTrigger>
    <MenuContent class="bg-background text-foreground z-50 rounded-lg border p-1 shadow-lg">
      <MenuItem onSelect={props.onSignOut}>Sign out</MenuItem>
    </MenuContent>
  </Menu>
);

import { cn } from "cn";
import type { ComponentProps } from "react";

export const Alert = ({
  variant,
  className,
  ...props
}: ComponentProps<"div"> & { variant?: "destructive" }) => (
  <div
    {...props}
    role="alert"
    data-variant={variant}
    className={cn(
      "data-[variant=destructive]:text-destructive relative rounded-lg border p-3",
      className
    )}
  />
);

export const AlertTitle = ({ className, ...props }: ComponentProps<"p">) => (
  <p {...props} className={cn("font-medium", className)} />
);

export const AlertDescription = ({
  className,
  ...props
}: ComponentProps<"div">) => (
  <div {...props} className={cn("text-sm", className)} />
);

export const AlertAction = ({ className, ...props }: ComponentProps<"div">) => (
  <div {...props} className={cn("mt-2", className)} />
);

import { Button as Primitive } from "@ui-sdk/react/button";
import { cva } from "class-variance-authority";
import type { VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import type { ComponentProps } from "react";

export const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md font-medium focus-visible:outline-2 disabled:opacity-50",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        primary: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground",
        outline: "border",
        ghost: "hover:bg-muted",
        link: "underline underline-offset-4",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-9 px-4",
        sm: "h-8 px-3",
        lg: "h-10 px-5",
        "icon-sm": "size-8",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { variant: "primary", size: "default" },
  }
);

export const Button = ({
  size,
  variant,
  className,
  ...props
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Primitive>, "className"> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & { className?: string }) => (
  <Primitive
    {...props}
    className={buttonVariants({ size, variant, className })}
  />
);

"use client";

import {
  Checkbox as Primitive,
  CheckboxIndicator,
} from "@ui-sdk/react/checkbox";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import type { ComponentProps } from "react";

export const Checkbox = ({
  onCheckedChange,
  ...props
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Primitive>, "onCheckedChange"> & {
  onCheckedChange: (checked: boolean) => void;
}) => (
  <Primitive
    {...props}
    onCheckedChange={(next) => {
      onCheckedChange(next === true);
    }}
    className="inline-grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded border"
  >
    <CheckboxIndicator>
      <Check aria-hidden="true" className="size-3" />
    </CheckboxIndicator>
  </Primitive>
);

"use client";

import { MenuContent, MenuItem } from "@ui-sdk/react/menu";
import { cn } from "cn";
import type { ComponentProps } from "react";
import { useId } from "react";

export {
  Menu as DropdownMenu,
  MenuGroup as DropdownMenuGroup,
  MenuGroupLabel as DropdownMenuLabel,
  MenuSeparator as DropdownMenuSeparator,
  MenuTrigger as DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@ui-sdk/react/menu";

export const DropdownMenuContent = ({
  className,
  ...props
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof MenuContent>, "className"> & {
  className?: string;
}) => (
  <MenuContent
    {...props}
    className={cn(
      "bg-background text-foreground z-50 rounded-md border p-2 shadow-lg",
      className
    )}
  />
);

export const DropdownMenuItem = ({
  value,
  variant,
  ...props
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof MenuItem>, "value"> & {
  value?: string;
  variant?: "destructive";
}) => {
  const id = useId();

  return (
    <MenuItem
      value={value ?? id}
      destructive={variant === "destructive"}
      className="data-[highlighted]:bg-muted flex items-center gap-2 rounded p-2"
      {...props}
    />
  );
};

import {
  Menu,
  MenuContent,
  MenuRadioGroup,
  MenuRadioItem,
  MenuTrigger,
} from "@ui-sdk/react/menu";

export const ThemeMenu = ({
  disabled,
  value,
  onValueChange,
}: {
  disabled: boolean;
  value: string | undefined;
  onValueChange: (theme: string) => void;
}) => (
  <Menu>
    <MenuTrigger className="rounded-md border px-3 py-1" disabled={disabled}>
      Toggle theme
    </MenuTrigger>
    <MenuContent className="bg-background text-foreground z-50 rounded-lg border p-1 shadow-lg">
      <MenuRadioGroup name="Theme" onValueChange={onValueChange} value={value}>
        {["Light", "Dark", "System"].map((theme) => (
          <MenuRadioItem
            className="data-[highlighted]:bg-muted rounded px-3 py-1 data-[checked]:font-bold"
            key={theme}
            value={theme.toLowerCase()}
          >
            {theme}
          </MenuRadioItem>
        ))}
      </MenuRadioGroup>
    </MenuContent>
  </Menu>
);

#   solid-spa-ui-sdk-expo-docker
#   solid-spa-ui-sdk-expo-docker-e2e
import { createLocalStorage } from "@ui-sdk/core";
import {
  Menu,
  MenuContent,
  MenuRadioGroup,
  MenuRadioItem,
  MenuTrigger,
} from "@ui-sdk/solid/menu";
import { createSignal } from "solid-js";

const applyTheme = (value: string) => {
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", value === "dark");
};

export const ThemeMenu = () => {
  const storage = createLocalStorage("theme");
  const initial = storage.get() ?? "light";
  const [theme, setTheme] = createSignal(initial);

  applyTheme(initial);

  return (
    <Menu>
      <MenuTrigger class="rounded-md border px-3 py-1">
        Toggle theme
      </MenuTrigger>
      <MenuContent class="bg-background text-foreground z-50 rounded-lg border p-1 shadow-lg">
        <MenuRadioGroup
          name="Theme"
          value={theme()}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            setTheme(value);
            storage.set(value);
            applyTheme(value);
          }}
        >
          <MenuRadioItem value="light">Light</MenuRadioItem>
          <MenuRadioItem value="dark">Dark</MenuRadioItem>
        </MenuRadioGroup>
      </MenuContent>
    </Menu>
  );
};
